title: Many Solutions, One Answer: Search Order Shapes the Default Solutions of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a constraint puzzle has several correct answers, language models tend to give the same one.We study four open-weight models from three families on symbolic puzzles and multi-solution ZebraLogic variants with exactly known solution sets.Repeated samples concentrate on one default solution far beyond uniform sampling, and different models often share it.Yet models usually produce even rarely sampled solutions when added clues uniquely identify them.On held-out symbolic puzzles, we compare visiting entities in name order with visiting those with the fewest initial candidates first. Both searches try values in the stated order. Where their pre-specified predictions differ, the latter matches a larger share of responses in all four models, by 26 to 40 percentage points.Reversing the stated value order or specifying a search order shifts responses towards the solution that the new order favours, on both testbeds. Randomising the present

translated_title: 多解一答：搜索顺序塑造语言模型的默认解
translated_abstract: 当一个约束谜题存在多个正确答案时，语言模型往往给出同一个答案。我们在符号谜题以及解集完全已知的多解ZebraLogic变体上，研究了来自三个家族的四个开放权重模型。重复采样高度集中于某一个默认解，其集中程度远超均匀采样，而且不同模型常常共享这个默认解。然而，当新增线索能唯一确定某个解时，即使该解很少被采样，模型通常也能将其给出。在留出的符号谜题上，我们比较了两种实体访问策略：按名称顺序访问实体，与优先访问初始候选最少的实体。两种搜索都按给定的顺序尝试取值。在二者预先指定的预测不同的地方，后者在所有四个模型中匹配了更大比例的回答，领先幅度达26至40个百分点。在两个测试平台上，反转给定的取值顺序或指定搜索顺序，都会使模型的回答偏向新顺序所偏好的解。随机化当前的……
tldr: 论文发现语言模型在多解约束谜题中高度集中于同一个默认解，其行为如同按特定顺序遍历的搜索求解器——优先访问初始候选最少的实体这一搜索顺序最能预测模型输出，且改变给定的顺序会相应改变模型的默认解。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that language models concentrate on a single default solution in multi-solution constraint puzzles, behaving like solvers with a specific search order: visiting entities with the fewest initial candidates first best predicts model outputs, and altering the stated order shifts the default solution accordingly.
